title: Desktop release: name and signing
context: The desktop app builds for Linux, Windows and Mac in two versions. On Linux both play to the first goal from the encrypted pack. The Windows installer runs under Wine, and the Mac zips (Apple Silicon and Intel) are built but have not run on a real Mac yet. How to build: docs/desktop-release.md.

Without signing, Windows shows a SmartScreen warning before the first start, and on a Mac players have to allow the app by hand in System Settings. Signing on Windows needs a code-signing certificate (yearly, from a certificate seller). On a Mac it needs an Apple Developer account at 99 USD a year for notarization.
The second version needs its own name so both can be installed side by side. The working name is Amakawa Complete.
question: Should we ship unsigned for now or get signing, and is Amakawa Complete the right name for the second version?

options.label: unsigned
options.note: Ship unsigned for now; players click past the warning. Decide on signing later.

options.label: sign-mac
options.note: Get an Apple Developer account and notarize the Mac build.

options.label: name-complete
options.note: Call the second version Amakawa Complete (write another name in the comment if not).

ask: In the comment: do you have a Windows PC or a Mac we can test the builds on, or should I find another way?
